Avery (Sales): handing off Helix Labs (HLX-501). signed today, ARR $48k. pilot start target: 2026-07-12. POC = Priya Rao (devops).

Avery (Sales): customer requirements: EU data residency, Okta SSO, weekly audit exports, and >=80 reqs/min burst. They asked for deterministic responses on compliance queries.

Maya (CS): i'll own onboarding. scheduling tech kickoff with Priya. need confirmation if private control plane required or dedicated pool acceptable.

Liam (CS Lead): label as renewal/expansion opportunity at month 9. risk: if 95p latency >130ms pilot may be cancelled. include perf SLOs in runbook.

Omar (Eng): i'll lead infra. please upload 50 anonymized request samples and avg token lengths. are FP models required?

Avery (Sales): samples in contract appendix (link shared). avg tokens ~50, embeddings batch size 1. they prefer FP for some flows but open to evaluation.

Sana (Support): i'll create the post-go-live support runbook and PD rotation for first 30 days. tag me on infra tickets.

legal-bot: SOC2 attestation and KMS policy docs added to thread. https://redwood.internal/security/HLX-501

Maya (CS): owners + next steps: Maya onboard lead, Omar infra ticket, Sana support/runbook, Liam renewal. i'll create runbook and set kickoff for next week.

Avery (Sales): intro email to Priya sent. will follow-up on network CIDRs for VPC peering.

Maya (CS): onboarding checklist in runbook:
- create org & staging env
- provision VPC & KMS keys
- validate Okta SSO
- deploy staging control plane
- baseline perf tests (95p latency)
- upload prompt set for quality baseline

Omar (Eng): opening INF-6229. please attach samples there. i'll reproduce tail latencies on dedicated pool by Tue.

Sana (Support): prepping SLA summary and incident handoff doc for kickoff.

Liam (CS Lead): action items: Maya schedule kickoff + runbook (Maya). Omar INF-6229 + repro (Omar). Sana PD + runbook (Sana). Avery follow up on CIDR/legal (Avery). follow-up 1 week after kickoff.

Maya (CS): kickoff scheduled Wed 2026-04-13 14:00 CET. invites sent.

Avery (Sales): thanks team :thumbsup:
